UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores student and admin profile information.

subject.description: The subject the student is studying.

assignedPapers.description: List of paper IDs assigned to the student.

role.description: The user's role in the system.

hasTakenDiagnostic.description: Whether the student has completed the diagnostic test.

updatedAt.description: When the user was last updated.

QuestionPaper.title: Question Paper
QuestionPaper.description: Stores metadata for uploaded PDF exam papers.

title.description: The title of the question paper.

year.description: The year of the exam session.

paperType.description: The type of paper (e.g., Paper 1, Paper 2).

description.description: A brief description of the paper.

pdfUrl.description: The URL to the PDF file in storage.

uploadedBy.description: The UID of the admin who uploaded the paper.

correctAnswers.description: Map of question numbers to correct answers (for Paper 1).

ExamResult.title: Exam Result
ExamResult.description: Stores student answers and scores for a specific paper.

paperId.description: The ID of the question paper.

answers.description: The student's answers for each question.

score.description: The student's score as a percentage.
